prompt:
Write a portfolio case study in Markdown for the freelancer Tobias Reyne (Full-stack developer - React, Next.js, Node.js and Postgres).

Project facts (the only truth you may use):
title: Booking platform for fitness studios
client: Pulsebox Studios
client_industry: fitness
start: 2020-03
end: 2020-08
engagement: fixed
stack:
- Next.js
- Node.js
- PostgreSQL
- Prisma
- Stripe
implied_skills:
- multi-tenancy
- subscription billing
built: A white-label class booking app where each studio gets its own subdomain, timetable
  and memberships.
metrics:
- 64 studios onboarded in 6 months
- 71% checkout conversion

Requirements:
- 300 to 450 words, first person, a short title line starting with "# ".
- Loosely cover the client's problem, what was built, and the results. Emphasis: the technical approach.
- Include one short code or config snippet (5 to 15 lines) in a fenced block that fits the stack.
- Refer to the client as "Pulsebox Studios".
- Never use these words or phrases: "multi-tenancy", "subscription billing". Describe the work so a reader can infer them.
